description: execute modifiers, conditions and store with scores and storage: if/unless score, store result score of fill, positioned and align, in the overworld, if blocks, scoreboard operations and data storage.

actions.command: execute if score a t matches 3 run setblock 0 1 0 minecraft:stone
execute store result score b t run fill 0 0 0 3 0 3 minecraft:dirt
execute if score b t matches 16 run setblock 1 1 0 minecraft:oak_log[axis=x]
execute in minecraft:overworld run setblock 3 1 3 minecraft:stone
execute align xyz positioned 2.7 1.2 0.4 run setblock ~ ~ ~ minecraft:bricks
execute if blocks 0 0 0 1 0 1 2 0 2 all run setblock 0 2 0 minecraft:gold_block
scoreboard players operation a t += b t
execute if score a t matches 19 run setblock 3 2 3 minecraft:diamond_block
data modify storage vanillite:test v set value 7
execute store result score c t run data get storage vanillite:test v
execute if score c t matches 7 unless block 0 3 0 minecraft:stone run setblock 0 3 0 minecraft:emerald_block
execute unless entity @e[type=minecraft:cow] run setblock 3 3 3 minecraft:sea_lantern
